{{Quote|There are a hundred different threats out there that would freeze your blood if you knew about them.|Stent, to [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Kres'ten'tarthi''',<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref> better known by his core name of '''Stent''', was one of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] followers of [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], better known as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn. Stent served the Grand Admiral as a [[TIE pilot]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> and the leader of his [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx|Household Phalanx]] troops.<ref name="RSBF" /> 

Although Thrawn [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], Stent remained loyal to him, and by [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], he was serving as [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of Thrawn's [[Phalanx (Chiss)|Household Phalanx]], based at the [[Hand of Thrawn]] on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]]. This was a "renegade phalanx" that was not part of the Chiss military and did not take orders from the Chiss government, but appears in practice to have operated under the command of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]. On at least one occasion, Stent explicitly identified the Phalanx as being under the authority of the [[Empire of the Hand]].

Stent was almost killed later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Battle of Rhigar|raid]] while visiting a [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy|military academy]] on<ref name="RSBF" /> [[Rhigar/Legends|Rhigar]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> but in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], he appeared again at Nirauan.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' resolved Stent's death timeline problem, stating that Stent survived the attack on the Rhigar academy.<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
